name: leetcode-sr
author: Vig
description: Windows desktop app for NeetCode 150 spaced repetition: daily reviews, goal-date pacing, offline SQLite progress — no cloud or account.

scripts.stress: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('.tmp-stress',{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}" && npx esbuild scripts/stress-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=scripts/stress-test.cjs && set LEETCODE_SR_DATA_DIR=.tmp-stress&& set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1&& electron scripts/stress-test.cjs
